categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three segments: computer motherboards, industrial computers, and graphics cards, along with related peripheral hardware and software development, manufacturing, and sales. In the latest fiscal year, computer motherboards accounted for 56% of consolidated revenue, graphics cards 11%, industrial computers 10%, and other products 23%. The company focuses on personal desktop motherboards, industrial computing systems, and gaming and AI-capable graphics cards.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops and manufactures products based on x86 architecture and collaborates with third-party NPU providers for AI edge computing solutions. It utilizes advanced platforms such as Intel's 800 series and AMD's 800 series motherboards supporting DDR5 memory and PCI-E Gen5. Production involves SMT (Surface Mount Technology) processes, automated testing, and quality control, with a focus on integrating AI and edge computing capabilities into industrial and commercial applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include commercial PC builders, industrial clients requiring edge computing and automation solutions, and gamers or consumers needing high-performance graphics cards. The company targets business markets, industrial automation sectors such as smart retail, smart manufacturing, and AI edge computing applications. Sales are primarily through distributors and partners, focusing on emerging markets and commercial clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in the Asia-Pacific region, which accounts for the majority of sales, followed by the Americas and Europe. It has subsidiaries and investments in the U.S. and Europe to support regional sales and operations. The company is exposed to currency fluctuations and geopolitical factors affecting emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of motherboards, industrial computers, and graphics cards. It sources key components such as chipsets, PCBs, and electronic components from established suppliers and integrates these into finished products for downstream customers including OEMs and end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the industrial computer market with AI edge computing solutions, leveraging x86 expertise, and partnering with third-party NPU providers to enter NVIDIA-led AI edge ecosystems. The company plans to develop AI-enabled motherboards and systems for smart retail, manufacturing, and automation. R&D focuses on Intel and AMD platform upgrades, AI applications, and next-generation graphics cards based on AMD RDNA 4 architecture, maintaining R&D investment at about 3% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of computer motherboards, industrial computers, and graphics cards. The company also derives income from licensing technology and software related to its hardware products. Sales are conducted via distributors, ODM customers, and direct commercial clients, with a focus on volume sales and strategic partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from major motherboard and graphics card manufacturers including Intel, AMD, NVIDIA, and other branded and white-label suppliers. It positions itself as a specialized provider with strong R&D capabilities in x86 platforms and AI edge computing, aiming to differentiate through service quality and strategic alliances, particularly with AMD for graphics cards and AI solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$2.02 billion in the latest fiscal year, a 14% decrease from the prior year, with a net profit of NT$6.6 million after tax. Despite revenue decline, gross margin improved from 6% to 8%. The company maintains a stable asset base of about NT$2.6 billion and equity of NT$2.17 billion, with ongoing investments in R&D and a positive cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes service quality over price to build customer trust and create value. It leverages extensive motherboard hardware R&D experience, supply chain familiarity, and customer insights to deliver tailored commercial and industrial computing solutions. Its focus on AI edge computing, integration with third-party NPUs, and expansion of AMD-based high-performance graphics cards provide competitive differentiation in emerging technology markets.
